tone.target: tight modern drop-D high-gain rhythm with scooped mids and sustained lead bite
tone.profile: tight modern drop-D high-gain rhythm with scooped mids and sustained lead bite
tone.summary: A modern metal/hard rock chain using a powerful distortion (RAT-style) into an aggressive amp model (Recti), paired with a 4x12 cab for maximum punch and low-end definition. Compression and gating ensure tight rhythm performance.
corrections: keep rhythm punch over vintage crunch

blocks.purpose: Eliminate hum and noise from heavy palm-muting.
Slightly push the signal into the distortion stage for maximum saturation.
blocks.gap: No specific boost needed, but a slight gain lift helps drive the high-gain tone.

blocks.purpose: Provide thick, saturated distortion suitable for modern metal chugs.
Even out the dynamics of palm-muted chugs and sustain power chords.
Achieve the required scooped mid rhythm tone characteristic of modern metal.
Simulate a modern, aggressive high-gain amp suitable for metal rhythm work.
Provide a punchy and aggressive cabinet sound matching the modern metal genre.
Add subtle sustain and depth without sounding ambient or washing out the rhythm.
blocks.gap: The target tone avoids 'ambient delay,' so a subtle reverb is used purely for dimension, not effect.

improvements.summary: Upgrade the cabinet IR for better definition and aggression required by modern metal.
